candidate_requirements.requirement: Specify a plan to obtain serial oedema and laboratory trend data (weights, albumin, creatinine, urine protein:creatinine ratio) to track progression and drug-relatedness.
candidate_requirements.rationale: No withdrawal response or follow-up data are supplied, so prospective trend data are needed for the required monitoring plan.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Any defensible schedule of clinical and laboratory reassessment without new prescriptions.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed requests to be included in the written monitoring plan at this decision point.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request confirmation of the complete current medication list, including ACE inhibitor dose and any recent changes or supportive drugs.
candidate_requirements.rationale: ACE inhibitor use and polypharmacy could contribute to oedema or renal changes and only a partial list is supplied.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Medication reconciliation by pharmacy or records review.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request within the written review plan.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request assessment of nutritional status and protein intake.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Malnutrition is a plausible hypoalbuminaemia mechanism not excluded by the supplied workup.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Dietitian review or documented nutritional screen.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request within the written review plan.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request further characterisation of the renal lesion if proteinuria interpretation remains uncertain (e.g., quantified proteinuria or renal referral considerations).
candidate_requirements.rationale: The discordant protein:creatinine ratio versus microalbuminuria leaves the renal mechanism incompletely defined.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Any justified renal-focused follow-up test or documented decision not to test further.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request within the written review plan.
